description: Classic Azure DevOps Release definition for the FF Playwright/ReqnRoll/NUnit automation artifact. After import, reselect the primary Build artifact produced by the CI pipeline (artifact name: testpackage) and keep/reapply artifact alias _FF_CI; then select a Windows agent queue for each stage. The stages are intentionally independent/manual: Assembly Execution runs DLLs with an optional VSTest filter; Test Suite Execution runs one or more automated suites from a plan/configuration; Test Plan On-Demand Execution is the release stage selected from Azure Test Plans and consumes $(test.RunId), with ManualTestRunId as a fallback. Set credential variables as secrets before execution.
